text:
maria: Quick sync — polishing landing copy for the three deployment experiences (hosted / dedicated / private). Primary asks: tighten hero microcopy, add a single benchmark card, gate deep appendix behind webinar reg, and ensure leads route by selected mode. Two-week runway?
leo: Two weeks works. I'll take the hero copy iterations + frame them in Figma by Thu.
anika: I'll write 3 short mode blurbs (one sentence each) and a single comparison stat for the hero card.
joel: I'll draft the launch post narrative: bench highlight -> use case -> webinar CTA. Keep it under 350 words.
tess: I'll build the webinar page + form and wire HubSpot tags. Confirm mapping: mode=hosted -> inbound SDR; mode=dedicated -> AE queue; mode=private -> AE + SE.
maria: Yes. Add fields: mode, region, primary_use_case. Use utm_campaign=tri_modal_launch and include utm_content=hero_variant. Gate the "latency-appendix.pdf" behind registration.
leo: Hero candidates (concise):
  Hosted: "Hosted API — start fast, scale as you need."
  Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity — steady throughput, predictable latency."
  Private: "Private deployment — keep inference in your network."
anika: Alternative tone (ops-forward):
  Hosted: "Low ops. Instant API."
  Dedicated: "Reserved GPUs. Stable SLOs."
  Private: "VPC-ready. Compliance-first."
joel: Draft outline for blog post: 1) one-line benchmark takeaway (hosted vs dedicated p95 delta), 2) quick product explainer for each mode, 3) brief customer vignette (search ingestion), 4) register for webinar + download appendix.
tess: Form snippet to capture mode: <input type="hidden" name="mode" value="${MODE}">. HubSpot routing pseudo: if(mode=='hosted') tag='inbound_hosted' else if(mode=='dedicated') tag='ae_dedicated' else tag='ae_private'; createContact(contact, [tag, utm_campaign]);
maria: CTA variants to test (14 days): A) "Get started — Hosted" / "Reserve capacity — Dedicated" / "Request private demo"; B) "Try hosted now" / "Talk to sales — Dedicated" / "Book private consult". Experiment key: launch_tri_modal_cta_v1.
leo: Microcopy subhead for hero: "Same API. Pick your SLA." short and clear.
anika: Benchmark blurb (draft): "In our internal tests, Dedicated reduced p95 by ~30% versus default hosted under steady throughput; see appendix for methodology." I'll attach CSV with test rig in the one-pager.
joel: Social copy draft (short): "New: three ways to serve LLMs — hosted, dedicated, private. Join our webinar for benchmarks + demo. [link] #LLM #inference"
tess: I'll set registration default to Hosted if no mode param present. Also adding hidden utm_source param when the link comes from social posts.
ops-bot: Reminder: marketing deploy window Fri 09:00 PT. Please upload final assets to /releases/marketing by Thu 20:00 PT.
maria: Action items recap: leo — Figma heroes + export (Thu), anika — blurbs + CSV (Wed), joel — post draft + scheduling (Wed), tess — webinar page + HubSpot workflow (Mon). Dry-run Mon 30m before webinar. Thanks team! :rocket:
